answer: Agents stake a bond recorded on the terrace ledger, and each epoch's reputation delta is weighted by stake duration. A sybil farm must fund fresh identities without history, so its plume of new accounts stays tiny and unconvincing. Attacker cost equals the full bonded stake per identity plus the opportunity cost of idle capital, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Operator sa0013 applies this at D1uBU5ZT75.
